name: ThePlotSale
summary: A bespoke full-stack CMS and digital platform for high-end land and property operations, replacing off-the-shelf real-estate software with a purpose-built parcel system.
problem: Generic real-estate templates force land listings into bedroom/bathroom schemas that cannot express plot zoning, dimensional frontage, utilities or topography.
solution: A bespoke parcel schema with dimensional attributes and zoning categories, dynamic listing modules, a custom admin CMS and a cinematic public interface.
built: Dynamic property listing modules, a custom backend management system and a premium cinematic UI with scalable architecture for high-resolution international listings.
outcome: A purpose-built land listing platform that presents commercial parcel parameters cleanly and helps brokers convert online interest into serious inquiries.

caseStudyContent.role: Full-stack product developer: dynamic listing modules, custom CMS backend, responsive presentation and search architecture.

name: Vibe Living DXB
summary: A fully dynamic, high-end real-estate platform for a premier Dubai property firm where every section — areas, listings, agents and homepage — is CMS-managed.
problem: A boutique Dubai luxury operator needed an editorial web platform matching their brand while letting non-technical marketing staff update listings, pricing and area guides without code.
solution: A custom CMS-driven architecture separating managed content from presentation, with advanced filtering and a sophisticated ultra-luxury UI.
built: CMS-driven listings, areas, agent profiles and homepage content with elegant property discovery, advanced filtering and responsive brand experience.
outcome: A publicly accessible real-estate website backed by a custom content management architecture; the client team publishes new properties and guides without technical assistance.

cover.alt: Vibe Living DXB luxury Dubai real-estate homepage

caseStudyContent.role: Lead full-stack engineer: architectural layout, dynamic filtering, custom CMS schema, responsive design and SEO optimization.

name: Edwardian Academy ERP
summary: A centralized MERN-stack Educational Resource Planning system with physical barcode-scanner attendance, deployed to a managed Linux VPS.
problem: Hundreds of daily students checked in on paper registers, causing front-desk congestion, attendance tampering and days of manual monthly reporting.
solution: A MERN ERP with a USB/HID barcode scanner event pipeline for sub-second attendance, deployed on a Hostinger VPS with Nginx reverse proxy and PM2.
built: Barcode attendance integration, administrative workflows, database hosting and full-stack VPS deployment from scratch.
outcome: Eliminated the morning front-desk bottleneck with sub-second check-in and tamper-proof digital records, saving dozens of hours of monthly admin reporting.

media.note: Source capture includes browser chrome and OS taskbar; presented as a safe center crop in a frame until a clean capture is supplied.

caseStudyContent.role: Full-stack product engineer: MERN architecture, barcode scanner event pipeline, Hostinger VPS deployment and Linux server routing.

name: Bun
summary: A cinematic full-stack restaurant ordering platform and POS bridging customer digital ordering with staff-facing kitchen display and cashier operations.
problem: Customer ordering detached from kitchen preparation queues causes communication lag, sold-out errors and slow table turnover during peak hours.
solution: A dual-surface architecture: an expressive customer ordering UI connected to a live staff POS with kitchen order queues and role-based access.
built: Category filtering, quick-add modifier modal with upsells, slide-in cart with itemized receipts, live kitchen order queue, menu CRUD and RBAC admin.
outcome: A complete ordering-to-fulfillment pipeline that eliminates order translation errors between dining room and kitchen.

caseStudyContent.role: Full-stack product engineer: dual-surface architecture, live state management, receipt generator and deployment.

name: 7dot
summary: A quiet-luxury cosmetics e-commerce platform pairing interactive shade discovery with an administrative inventory and fulfillment dashboard.
problem: Online cosmetic retail suffers high return rates when customers cannot gauge true shades and finishes digitally.
solution: An interactive shade-matching picker with high-resolution texture swatches and undertone guidance, plus clean back-office fulfillment tools.
built: Shade-matching quizzes, live lip-tint swatches, smooth scrolling, slide-in cart drawer and a multi-role admin dashboard for inventory and orders.
outcome: An elevated beauty shopping experience pairing editorial aesthetics with rigorous inventory and order-fulfillment controls.

caseStudyContent.role: Full-stack product engineer: shade-matching quiz, interactive swatch UI, cart drawer and administrative fulfillment dashboard.

name: Sufi Glass
summary: A centralized financial ERP and stock administration system for wholesale glass distribution, connected to live production data.
problem: Orders, cutting specifications and credit collections lived across paper ledgers and manual calculations, causing quote errors and slow invoicing.
solution: A custom dimensional rate engine and a native transactional ledger in MongoDB, giving financial screens one common data foundation.
built: Sales invoices, quotations, receipt and expense tracking, glass master rate catalogs, 7-day collection trends and automated customer directories.
outcome: Replaced fragmented manual ledgers with a unified operational ERP; quotes and invoices calculate in seconds and inventory syncs on dispatch.

cover.alt: Sufi Glass financial dashboard with live collection data

media.note: Real operational dashboard presented in a console frame; the live data is the proof.

caseStudyContent.role: Full-stack product engineer: database architecture, business logic, financial calculators, admin UI and deployment.

name: CaveClan
summary: A visually rich, on-scroll immersive website for a premium luxury studio art brand that turns scrolling into an artistic narrative.
problem: A high-end studio art brand needed a digital presence as considered and cinematic as its physical productions.
solution: A bespoke scroll-triggered design system with GSAP-driven narrative sequencing and luxurious visual storytelling.
built: Meticulously crafted scroll-triggered animations, luxurious visual storytelling and a bespoke design system for high-end brand presentation.
outcome: An immersive brand experience that presents the studio's work as a continuous cinematic narrative.

caseStudyContent.role: Frontend architect and motion designer: scroll choreography, bespoke design system and cinematic presentation.
